CustomField.description: Sampling temperature (0-2) sent on every extraction callout. Replaces the inline literal 0 in LLMExtractionCalloutService.buildRequestBody. 0 = fully deterministic, the value this pipeline was built and tested against — raising it introduces run-to-run variance in the SAME broker_email / property_address fields the registry claim key depends on. Treat any change away from 0 as a claim-key-behaviour change, not a routine tuning knob.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: 0-2. 0 = deterministic (tested value). Raising it adds variance to the broker/property claim key.
CustomField.label: Temperature
